Living religious heritage

About this place

Shekharnagar gives visitors a reason to explore Sirajdikhan beyond the main heritage circuit. It pairs naturally with an introduction to the upazila’s pottery traditions, which have long served households, fairs and religious celebrations.

Ask the caretakers about access and seek permission for photography.
